items.title: Kohl's partners with DoorDash for fast delivery
items.summary: Kohl's is now offering same-day delivery through DoorDash to help customers get products quickly.

items.title: Gap Stock Jumps After Strong Earnings, Upbeat Guidance and a New Old Navy CEO
items.summary: Gap said it earned 52 cents a share in the fiscal second quarter, excluding tariff refund benefits, on revenue that fell 2% from the year-ago period to $3.65 billion.

items.title: How to Play Meta Platforms Stock Before It Launches a Consumer AI Agent
items.summary: As Meta moves closer to launching its consumer AI agent Hatch , its expansive AI ambitions could provide a fresh catalyst for META stock.

items.title: Circle Internet stock falls after banks eye stablecoin launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) shares fell 4% Wednesday following a Wall Street Journal report that banks are now considering launching their own stablecoins after previously opposing them.

items.title: Reddit (RDDT) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of online community and discussion platform Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) jumped 4.9% in the afternoon session after The Information reported that Meta Platforms is preparing to launch a consumer AI agent named Hatch that is trained to access and browse the social discussion platform.
